title_en: Chinese Science Fiction (16/20): Waiting on the Far Side of the Moon
note_en: Notice 一边……一边…… in 林队长却一边检查设备，一边讲笑话 "Captain Lin checked the equipment and told jokes at the same time." Chinese marks two simultaneous actions by putting 一边 before each verb, where English uses "while" or "at the same time" only once. The same text shows another compact pattern, 比黑暗更可怕的是孤独 "more frightening than darkness is loneliness," where the 比 comparison comes first and the answer is saved for the end.
